title: Creamy Garlic Chicken With Rice and Spinach
instructions: Chop up the chicken into cubes and mix it with salt and spices.
Fry the meat on a skillet or directly in a pot with a bit of oil until brown and crispy.
Add chopped up garlic and fry alongside the meat for about 30s.
Put everything into a pot if not already, and add rice and broth. Stir well and cook as you would cook normal rice – low heat and covered.
Once the rice is done, remove the pot from the heat and add the spinach leaves. Give it a stir if you want to, but do not release too much heat.
Cover with a lid again and wait 5 minutes till the leaves wilt.
Stir it properly while mixing in some heavy cream until it has nice, creamy consistency.
